text:
maya: Heads-up: rolling network schema migration for tenant-enclave during prod-west change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need terraform apply coordination, routing-policy handoff, and IAM role rotation. ping @joel @sarah @ashok

deploybot: deploybot queued terraform apply for infra/tenant-enclave v2026.03.21-rc1. Will start at 02:10 UTC unless a hold is set.

joel: quick check — plan looks limited: new route table + a security group tweak. I'll run a staging dry-run now and post plan snippet.

joel: ```
+ aws_route.table["tenant-enclave"]
~ aws_security_group.enclave[0] updated (ingress 443: allowed from 10.0.0.0/16)
```

sarah: routing team on standby for potential BGP flaps. Requesting drain-time 60s for endpoints, and confirm there are no elastic IP reassigns in this change.

ashok: security note: IAM role change touches cross-account assume-role. Need manual approval from sec-approvers before apply. Also KMS key policy gets a minor statement change — plan will require post-apply verification for key grants.

maya: acknowledged. I'll open the approval request in the release notes PR and pin provider to `hashicorp/aws` 4.77.0 in the branch to avoid drift.

tina: oncall protocol: if deploybot reports >10% 5xx across infra services we abort and run rollback. Add escape hatch: snapshot tfstate and keep a restore command ready — e.g., `terraform state rm module.tenant.aws_route` or reapply previous snapshot.

joel: prefer rollforward unless state is corrupted. I created a tfstate snapshot at s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/1743210000.snap before starting.

deploybot: deploybot starting staged apply in prod-west-1 [step 1/3] at 02:12 UTC. Live logs -> https://deploy.redwood/1743210000 (CI job 5421).

maya: checklist: - change window locked? yes - release-notes published? pending - sec approval? pending - merge queue clear? @ci-bot status?

ci-bot: merge queue clear, all tests green. release-notes PR #242 merged.

maya: ashok please approve in next 3 mins or we'll defer to midnight window.

ashok: approved. reviewed KMS GRANT and assume-role policy, lgtm :thumbsup:.

deploybot: deploybot step 2/3: terraform apply completed with 2 warnings, 0 errors. Resources changed: 4 added, 1 updated. Beginning routing handoff.

sarah: routing team shifting 10% traffic to the new route table now. Health probes green. grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/d/tenant-enclave/health

tina: metrics check: latency +1.2% (baseline 45ms -> 46.5ms), error rate unchanged. within SLO.

joel: rotating ephemeral ARNs for the new role; will finish rotation and run integration smoke at 02:25.

maya: rollforward path looks green. I'll append to release notes: "Network schema migration completed; rolled out to prod-west; no customer impact observed." Flagging for post-release log collection for 24h.

deploybot: deploybot apply completed 02:29 UTC. Snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/1743210000.complete. Rollback command included in snapshot metadata if needed.

tina: moving to monitoring-only. Thanks team :tada:
